layers.label: Basemap
lineage: OSM vector tiles rendered by OpenFreeMap; contextual backdrop only, not a measured layer

layers.label: Building footprints
layers.source: Overture Maps Foundation (ODbL) -- OSM + Google + Microsoft, GERS-deduplicated
lineage: Overture GERS-deduplicated merge of OSM + Google + Microsoft
placed within 2.4 cm of the source coordinate after the 2026-08-05 frame fix; residual positional error is inherited, not corrected
layers.confidence: per-building receipt in {ward}-provenance.json (human-traced vs model, with the source's own confidence where published)

layers.label: Building heights
lineage: zonal-mean height per footprint from the 2.5D raster
known ~17% low bias vs OSM levels (averaging pulls in courtyards/annexes); unvalidated, ground truth needs LiDAR
layers.confidence: indicative; not independently validated (ICESat-2 cohort underpowered, n=28<30)

layers.label: Vegetation & albedo
layers.source: Sentinel-2 L2A via AWS earth-search STAC / public sentinel-cogs bucket (keyless)
lineage: Sentinel-2 L2A surface reflectance via the Earth Search STAC API
NDVI -> fractional vegetation cover; albedo via band coefficients
each channel additively shifted so its ward mean equals the measured DC-URS scalar: the PATTERN is measured, the LEVEL is the approved input
layers.confidence: measured spatial pattern at the DC-URS-approved level

layers.label: Tree canopy height
layers.source: Meta / World Resources Institute 1 m Global Canopy Height Model
lineage: Meta+WRI 1 m canopy-height model (neural height regression on Maxar imagery, ~2018-2020 epoch)
clipped to the 1400 m ward window and resampled (area-average) to the 140x140 served grid
tree instances scattered from the canopy field (density-weighted by height, deterministic jitter; thin canopy left empty); heights measured, positions/species modelled
layers.confidence: canopy extent/height indicative (MAE ~ few m); individual trees are modelled, not surveyed

layers.label: Terrain relief
layers.source: AWS Open Data terrain tiles (terrarium z15; SRTM-derived over India)

licence.name: elevation public domain (SRTM/NASA); tile assembly per Mapzen attribution list

lineage: terrarium z15 tiles cropped to the 1400 m window, ~40 m median-filtered, clamped to ±12 m, baked to a 128² heightfield
vs Copernicus GLO-30 over the same window: shape agreement r=0.49/0.48/0.67, per-cell RMSE 1.5-2.1 m against a 4.9-7.7 m relief. Two instruments disagree by ~a quarter of the signal.
layers.confidence: smoothed surface model, indicative broad-scale form -- NOT surveyed ground and NOT used by the simulation

layers.label: Water bodies
lineage: OSM natural=water / waterway polygons clipped to the ward window

layers.label: Roads & labels
lineage: OSM highway centrelines + street names clipped to the ward window

layers.label: Land-surface temperature (calibration)
layers.source: NASA ECOSTRESS + Landsat 8/9 C2 L2 (via Microsoft Planetary Computer)
lineage: thermal reference the model is calibrated and validated against, not a rendered layer
leave-one-overpass-out validation; bootstrap CIs over overpasses (see accuracy.ts)
layers.confidence: published per-phase accuracy bands with 95% CIs (accuracy.ts)

layers.label: Live ambient weather
lineage: live air temperature / wind / cloud forcing fetched per ward at runtime
